g.text: 8192 environments, two action dimensions, C layout. Medians of three independent tracemalloc peaks.
Warm fixtures and input arrays exist before tracing. Peaks are not process RSS or training throughput.
Mixed activity and small batches remain signed controls in all 78 raw scenarios per version.
Component savings are not overall memory savings; complete-step time is measured separately.
